thread:
maria: Quick heads up — onboarding rtx-13B-v2. Weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/rtx-13b-v2/ but when I try to load I get a shape mismatch on layer.attention.kv_proj.weight :/ Anyone seen this?
ajay: Which files are present? full list or a manifest?
maria: There's a manifest.json plus shards: pytorch_model-00000-of-00008.bin.gz ...-00007-of-00008.bin.gz and tokenizer files. Manifest lists sizes and blobs with checksums. I copied locally with aws s3 cp then gunzip -> still mismatch.
ben-g: Two quick things: 1) confirm if the manifest checksum is for the compressed blob or the uncompressed bytes. 2) check for shard ordering + missing bytes. Gz can change byte-level checksums. Try this to validate a shard locally:
  aws s3 cp s3://redwood-models/rtx-13b-v2/pytorch_model-00001-of-00008.bin.gz - | gunzip -c > local.bin; sha256sum local.bin
Then inspect keys to ensure it's a model state_dict and the expected shapes:
  python - <<PY
import torch
s = torch.load('local.bin', map_location='cpu')
print('keys', len(s.keys()))
print(list(s.keys())[:12])
PY
sasha: Also watch tokenizer format: we had an HF export that used tokenizer.json only and another that had vocab+merges. The tokenizer variant changed bos_token_id from 0 -> 1 which shifts embedding indices. Run a quick check: 
  python - <<PY
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
t = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('./tokenizer')
print('bos', t.bos_token, 'bos_id', t.bos_token_id)
PY
maria: That was it — my loader assumed bos=0. After swapping the token id mapping locally the shapes aligned. We should bake tokenizer metadata into the model manifest so the runtime can auto-normalize.
ajay: For access — do you need presigned URLs or an IAM role for eng-ml? I can do either. Note: S3 ETag is unreliable for multipart uploads; manifest should keep sha256 for validation.
maria: Presigned URLs would be easiest for QA and infra for the next 24h. Also the internal artifact registry expects manifest.blobs entries with explicit sha256 fields. Right now manifest has etag fields from S3 which don't help when multipart was used.
infra-bot: Created presigned URLs for the 8 shards and manifest: https://presigned.example/rtx-13b-v2/?X (expires in 24h) :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Registered artifact in artifact-registry at s3://artifact-registry/rtx/rtx-13b-v2/manifest.json — please confirm the 'blobs' array includes 'uncompressed_sha256' for each shard. Also include tokenizer_metadata with keys: format, bos_token_id, special_tokens_map.
ben-g: My quick checklist for onboarding uploads (shareable): 
  1) verify shard count and sizes match manifest
  2) compute sha256 of uncompressed shards and compare to manifest.uncompressed_sha256
  3) load a subset of state_dict keys to confirm shapes
  4) validate tokenizer.bos/eos/pad ids and vocab size
  5) run a tiny smoke inference (1-2 tokens) to sanity-check outputs
maria: Smoke test passed after token id fix, outputs look sane. Leaving a note to add tokenizer_metadata and uncompressed_sha256 to the manifest for future uploads. @ajay can you extend presigned links if needed? :pray:
ajay: Extended to 48h for eng-ml on this artifact. :thumbsup:
